overview_description.description: Verdant offers an approach that occurs beyond the months of tax season. With accounting at the core, they work to build themselves and their business a plan to grow into the future. They focus on everything from traditional to digital media marketing as well as assess how their current marketing plan ranks among their competition. They offer Marketing and Strategy Services such as Advertising Audit, Advertising Strategy, Advertising Management, Strategic Planning, Social Media Marketing, Market Analysis, Brand Analysis, and Digital Marketing.

about_short_description.short_description: Verdant provides accounting, tax preparation and planning, marketing and wealth management services.

product.name: Accounting Services
product.description: Services including tax preparation, bookkeeping, business accounting, and assurance provided by licensed CPAs to manage financial records and maximize tax returns.

product.name: Tax Preparation and Planning
product.description: Preparation and planning of tax returns for individuals and businesses to ensure compliance and optimize tax savings.

product.name: Wealth Management Services
product.description: Financial planning and investment management services to help clients develop strategies for their financial goals.

product.name: Marketing and Creative Services
product.description: Marketing strategy, branding, web development, SEO, social media management, and content creation to support business growth and visibility.

product.name: Human Capital Services
product.description: Services focused on workplace policies, human resources strategies, and creating ideal work environments to support business goals.
